summary:
Main
Iron ore prices combined stability with weakness today. DCE most-traded closed unchanged at 687.5 yuan/mt, and all eight majorQingdao port product quotations were steady. The 61% and 65% port indices each fell 1 yuan while the 58% rose 1 yuan.
